name: markdownghosttables
description: Compact markdown tables that still look aligned: virtual (ghost) column alignment, per-column colors, compact/expand commands, format-on-save and optional Tab cell navigation.

commands.title: Markdown Ghost Tables: Compact tables (remove alignment padding)
Markdown Ghost Tables: Expand tables (align with real spaces)
Markdown Ghost Tables: Toggle features (status bar menu)

markdownGhostTables.ghostAlign.description: Render virtual (ghost) padding so compact tables look column-aligned on screen without writing spaces into the file.

markdownGhostTables.ghostShade.description: With column colors on: multiplier over the column's alpha for the ghost background. Tune live until the cell looks uniform; higher values make the ghost stand out as a subtle pill (crank it high to diagnose what paints where).

markdownGhostTables.bandShade.description: With column colors on: multiplier over each column's alpha for the band background. Live, like ghostShade (crank it high to diagnose what paints where).

markdownGhostTables.ghostTint.description: Background tint of the ghost padding when column colors are off (with them on, the ghost takes its column's exact shade).

markdownGhostTables.columnColors.description: Color each table column as a continuous band (rainbow-style): every cell's whole segment, separator row included; ghost padding included in the same flat shade.

markdownGhostTables.mode.description: The table mode: 'compact' (no alignment padding in the file; ghost alignment covers the screen) or 'expand' (real spaces). Drives format-on-save and Tab formatting. Teams can commit this per repo in .vscode/settings.json.

markdownGhostTables.formatOnSave.description: Normalize all tables to the mode when saving a markdown file.

markdownGhostTables.tabNavigation.description: Tab/Shift+Tab inside a table formats it to the mode and jumps between cells. Off by default. If the Markdown Table extension (takumii.markdowntable) is installed and the mode is 'expand', its Tab wins; in 'compact' mode this extension takes the Tab.
